name: Weighted Russian Twist
research: Seated, lean back 40 deg (root rot X -40; ACE V-twist ~45, library 'slightly'), root 0.12 m so the sit bones touch the floor (ischium offset rotated -> z ~0.02). Hip L (0.11,-0.037,0.155); knees 90 deg -> hip-ankle 0.636, ankle z 0.074 -> dy = sqrt(0.636^2-0.081^2) = 0.631 -> ankle (0.13,-0.668,0.074), feet flat. Shoulders (+-0.22, 0.243, 0.528). Start: dumbbell (handle along the trunk) in the left hand at torso (0.07,0.30,-0.18), 0.30 m in front of the shoulder line; |S-H| 0.381 -> elbow 102, elev 12.9, plane 46.8; right hand mirrors to x -0.07 beside the plate (edge -0.018). End: shoulders turn 45 deg to HIS RIGHT (toward the camera at -X) via spine Y -6/-8/-10/-11/-10 and neck -5 (ASSUMED: negative Y = turn right; flip all signs if the render turns left). Left hand crosses to torso (-0.18,0.27,-0.32) beside the right hip: |S-H| 0.579 -> elbow 30, elev 41.8, plane 136. Right hand (explicit, no prop) beside the outer plate at torso (-0.31,0.22,-0.30): elbow 101, elev 34.8, plane -40.3. Hips, knees and feet unchanged. Sources S1 Oliva-Lozano 2020, S2 ACE V-twist, S3 Calatayud 2019.
